arena.name: Treasure Island

location.name: Old Lighthouse
location.clue: A tall tower that guides ships at night.

location.name: Fishing Harbor
location.clue: Where boats rest and fishermen sell their catch.

location.name: Hidden Cave
location.clue: A dark hollow in the rocks where pirates once hid.

location.name: Silver Waterfall
location.clue: Fresh water falls from a high cliff here.

location.name: Ancient Fort
location.clue: Old stone walls built to protect the island.

location.name: Village Market
location.clue: A busy place where islanders trade fruit and fish.

location.name: Golden Beach
location.clue: Soft sand and waves on the southern shore.

location.name: Giant Treehouse
location.clue: A home built high among the branches.

location.name: Lost Ruins
location.clue: Broken pillars of a forgotten temple.

location.name: Campfire Circle
location.clue: Travellers gather here to share stories at night.
